section_summary.extract_value: This section, 'Limitations and Outlook', discusses several limitations of the current study. These include concerns about sample generalizability due to its healthy, high-functioning, and community-dwelling nature, the inability to establish cause-and-effect relationships, and the examination of age differences rather than age-related changes. Further limitations involve the assessment of only two Big Five personality traits, methodological issues related to the start day of diaries, the use of default priors in Bayesian modeling, potential lack of statistical power, and the reliance on single-item measures for key variables like gratitude and loneliness.
